references.text: Samson had also previously been tricked by a woman into revealing a secret, when his wife pressured him to tell the riddle.
Delilah used the same method that the Philistines asked her to use and pressed Samson repeatedly until he revealed the secret behind his strength.
The Philistine leaders returned with the money once Delilah had learned the secret, just as they had promised in this verse.
Saul's men betrayed David to Saul in a similar way by revealing his hiding place for a reward.
Judas betrayed Jesus for money, in the same way that Delilah was paid to betray Samson.
Michal's betrayal of Saul on David's behalf shows a similar theme of deception between close relationships.
The Nazirite vow explains the source of Samson's strength, which the Philistines wanted to find out.
